data.completion_memo: The Chat workspace header now renders the Chat's own `chat.<hash>` identity instead of `chat.runId`. `chatHeaderContext` (new desktop/src/chat/chatHeader.ts) composes workflow, branch and the Chat id, and still hides the browser preview placeholder so a New Chat shows no unresolvable id. The header keeps the prefix that names the stored entity, so the displayed value resolves directly against the local store's chat_streams / chat_projection keys. Verified with the new 4-case chatHeader.test.ts plus the full desktop chat suite (42 files, 264 tests) and `pnpm check` (tsc --noEmit), all green.
data.description: The Chat workspace header renders `chat.runId` in its context line, so the user sees (and copies) a `run.<hash>` value while the durable state is keyed by the Chat in `chat.<hash>` under the local store's `chat_streams` / `chat_projection` (identity_for_seed in desktop/src-tauri/src/runtime/history.rs derives both from the same seed). An agent handed the header value cannot tell it names a Chat. Render the self-describing Chat id (`chat.<hash>`) in the header context instead, keeping the browser preview placeholder out. Add a focused test for the header context.
data.title: Show the Chat id in the Chat header instead of the Run id
